items.title: Clarence Ford Interview, 1975-12-10
items.q: Rupert Rob plays guitar, he was our guitar player.

ctx.x: Did he play with Tommy originally? Probably did, yeah.

Yeah, he started out, he played bass, yeah. And then he left and went to California, Tommy Shelvin. All of us were in the Spoketee Washington High School band. And Rupert Robinson played, he's a cab driver right now. And you catch him every day right now on, by Wolverine, on Canal and Rapport. He's got a V8 cab, all the cabs are black, colored painted black. Rupert Rob plays guitar, he was our guitar player. Still plays? Yeah, he plays when he gets his job, but it's more or less a second, not a main way to make a…
He had a big arrangement right in front of him.
